changelog: v1.0.7: self-healing targets + device-truth diagnostics. The second field report (v1.0.6, probe=1 but all-zero data) proved the target loop was silently no-op'ing — b_load_targets returned empty, so check/fix/heartbeat all skipped while the UI claimed 心跳已发. Fixes: b_load_targets falls back to the default GMS target whenever targets.txt exists but yields no valid package lines (GMS protection can never silently die on a config glitch); fix.sh now reports 心跳 truthfully (未发 when GMS wasn't detected, instead of claiming 已发); b_pkg_installed gains a third dumpsys-based fallback (cmd path → pm path → dumpsys Package [ dump), so a dead `cmd` service with a live dumpsys still detects correctly; b_probe_ok rejects error banners printed on stdout (Unable/Denial/Exception/...) that previously counted as 'probe healthy'; check.sh prints compact [diag] lines every run — moddir, targets.txt valid-line/byte counts, raw cmd/pm outputs — so the next copied report pinpoints any remaining root cause. v1.0.6: probe-truth hardening. v1.0.5: one-tap diagnostic log copy. v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX. v1.0.3: dead-bridge read-only mode. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
